method: One hero + five distinct companions per team. Each pair plays both sides with the same seed and mirrored formations. Auto ultimates; nearest target. Attribute points allocated and legal skills learned. Gear is a three-piece sect set on the hero only. Prepared scenarios use campaign code for level-10 training/forging, elixir and dragon qigong on both teams.
caution: Descriptive team-presence rates; not causal tier rankings. Mirrored games and members of the same team are correlated. No independent-trial confidence interval is claimed. Random composition is not an optimized player strategy. Scenarios with 2/4/6 specify the hero sect count, not every sect present. No claim to cover all gear/qigong/priorities/manual choices or campaign pacing.
